description: Get the signed certificate PDF for an attested work, saving it to a local file. Pass `attestation` (the exact object returned by attest_file) right after attesting, to mint a freshly-signed PDF. Pass only `hash` to recover an already-archived certificate instead (no credential needed).

attestation.description: The full object returned by attest_file, to mint a new PDF.

save_to.description: Local file path to save the PDF to (default: ./certificato_<hash12>.pdf).

name: get_certificate_pdf
title: Get the certificate PDF
